raw_text:
PLAN "3-Week Reconditioning Block"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "return to pre-illness strength and work capacity"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Week 1 Reload" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body Intro":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Body Intro":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Hinge + Pull Intro":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x4 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          front_squat 3x5 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          bench_press 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m

  PHASE "Phase 2 - Week 2 Build" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Body Build":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x4 rpe 6.5 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 6.5 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x40 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Body Build":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x4 rpe 6.5 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Hinge + Press Build":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x3 rpe 6.5 rest 180 seconds
          front_squat 4x4 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m

  PHASE "Phase 3 - Week 3 Peak Back" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower Body Specific":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          leg_press 3x8 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x45 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Upper Body Specific":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Hinge Focus + Bench Volume":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 5x2 rpe 7 rest 210 seconds
          front_squat 4x3 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m

goals.name: return to pre-illness strength and work capacity
